description: Pontes, Viadutos e Passarelas is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Mapa que identifica a localização das pontes, viadutos e passarelas no Distrito Federal e suas dimensões territoriais. Não possui precisão cartográfica, servindo apenas de referência quanto ao uso e ocupação. Elaborados na escala de 1:1000 a partir da restituição elaborada e confeccionada pela TERRACAP e a SEGETH. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are pontes, viadutos, passarelas, elevados. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
